div.p: Can't find what you need? Send us a message above and we'll get back to you within a day.

details.p: Orders ship from Kochi within 24 hours. Metro cities usually receive them in 2–3 days, and the rest of India in 3–6 days. Shipping is free above ₹999.
Everything is roasted in small batches and sealed within 72 hours. Every pack carries its roast date, and most stay at their best for 4–6 months once opened and kept airtight.

details.summary: Can I add a personal note to a hamper?
details.p: Yes. Add your message at checkout and we'll handwrite it on a linen card tucked inside the hamper. Gift notes are always free.
Our freshness promise covers you. Send a photo within 7 days of delivery and we'll replace the item or refund it in full, no questions asked.
We currently ship across India only. For international corporate orders, write to our gifting team and we'll arrange a quote.
